issues.detail: Messages M67 and M71 incorrectly include decisions 'D7' and 'D8' in their artifact_refs array. The artifact_refs array must only contain artifact (A*) or task (T*) IDs, whereas decisions should be placed in decision_refs.

The text contains the forbidden word 'label'/'labels' (e.g., in M27, M28, M29, M30, M76), which is explicitly prohibited by the prompt instructions regarding explicit mentions of 'label', even if it is contextually relevant to the pharmacy domain.
Thread TH3 has 15 messages, which is slightly below the target_messages_range of [17, 25] specified in the blueprint, although it is within the absolute min/max limits.
